page: Getting started with Hono framework: quick setup, development, and deployment. Create project: npm create hono@latest my-app (or yarn, pnpm, bun, deno variants). Choose template (cloudflare-workers, aws-lambda, bun, deno, nodejs, vercel, nextjs, etc.). Install dependencies: npm i. Run development server: npm run dev, access http://localhost:8787. Hello World: app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hello Hono!')). Return JSON: c.json({ ok: true, message: '...' }). Path parameters: c.req.param('id'). Query parameters: c.req.query('page'). Response headers: c.header('X-Message', 'value'). HTTP methods: app.post(), app.delete(), app.put(). HTML via JSX: c.html(<Component />) (rename to .tsx). Raw Response: new Response('text'). Middleware: basicAuth, Bearer, JWT, CORS, ETag. Adapters for platform-specific features like WebSocket. Same code works on any runtime with different entry points. Questions: How do I create a new Hono project? What templates are available? How do I return JSON? How do I handle parameters? How do I use middleware? How do I deploy?

sections.manifest: Project creation with create-hono. Commands by package manager: npm create hono@latest, yarn create hono, pnpm create hono@latest, bun create, deno init --npm. Follow interactive prompts to select template. Templates include: aws-lambda, bun, cloudflare-pages, cloudflare-workers, deno, fastly, nextjs, nodejs, vercel. Template pulled into my-app directory. Install dependencies: npm i, yarn, pnpm i, bun i. Start development: npm run dev, yarn dev, pnpm dev, bun run dev. Access http://localhost:8787. Questions: Which templates are available? How do I create project? How do I start development?

Hello World application. File: src/index.ts (or .tsx for JSX). Imports: Hono from 'hono', runtime-specific adapters vary. Create app: new Hono(). Basic route: app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hello Hono!')). Export: export default app. Runtime entry points differ but application code same. TypeScript support without transpile awareness. Questions: What's the basic app structure? Do I need transpiling? What does export default do?

JSON responses. Method: c.json({ data }). Example: c.json({ ok: true, message: 'Hello Hono!' }). Route: app.get('/api/hello', (c) => c.json({...})). Content-Type automatically set to application/json. Questions: How do I return JSON? What Content-Type is used?

Path and query parameters with headers. Path parameter: c.req.param('id') in route /posts/:id. Query parameter: c.req.query('page'). Response header: c.header('X-Message', 'value'). Example: app.get('/posts/:id', (c) => {...}). Multiple HTTP methods: app.post(), app.delete(), app.put(). POST example: app.post('/posts', (c) => c.text('Created!', 201)). DELETE example: app.delete('/posts/:id', ...). Questions: How do I get path params? How do I get query params? How do I set headers? How do I handle POST/DELETE?

HTML responses via JSX. File: rename src/index.tsx for JSX support. Component syntax: const View = () => { return <html>...</html> }. Render component: app.get('/page', (c) => c.html(<View />)). Alternative: html Helper from 'hono/helpers/html'. Configure JSX per runtime (varies by platform). Questions: How do I write HTML? Do I need .tsx extension? How do I render JSX components?

Raw Response objects. Syntax: return new Response('text'). Use case: direct Response API control. Example: app.get('/', () => new Response('Good morning!')). Questions: When do I use raw Response? What can I do with it?

Built-in middleware for common tasks. basicAuth: authentication with username/password. Usage: app.use('/admin/*', basicAuth({...})). Other middleware: Bearer token, JWT, CORS, ETag. Third-party: GraphQL Server, Firebase Auth. Custom middleware: write your own. Questions: What middleware is built-in? How do I use basicAuth? What third-party middleware exists? How do I create middleware?

Adapters for platform-specific features. WebSocket example: import upgradeWebSocket from 'hono/cloudflare-workers'. Static files, platform functions require adapters. Use case: Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun specific features. Questions: What are adapters? When do I need adapters? How do I use WebSocket?

Next steps and platform guides. Same code works on all platforms with different entry points. Platform-specific guides for setup and deployment. Choose your target platform for detailed instructions. Questions: How do I deploy? Which platforms are supported? What's platform-specific?
